title: Rocket and white bean dip with crunchy veg

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Tinned beans, rocket, garlic, olive oil, hard cheese, lemon and fresh veg are all ordinary home ingredients with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including vegetarian hard cheese and a bag of rocket, is an everyday Tesco purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: Needs only a stick blender, jug, grater, knife and board, and the technique is simple blitzing and chopping.

works.reason: A drained tin of beans with a bag of rocket, oil, cheese and lemon blends into a sensible amount of dip for four, with plenty of crudités and water to loosen it if needed.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is believable to blitz the dip and cut four carrots, radishes and half a cauliflower, and there is no cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon zest and juice, is used, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A bright green rocket dip with spring radishes suits early April, and the rocket gives the dip its colour and flavour.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, friendly British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Beans, greens and raw vegetables make a filling, wholesome snack a family would happily eat again.
